item.title: Hunspell vs SymSpell vs Nuspell in 2026: Which Spell Checking Engine Should You Self-Host?
item.description: Here is the uncomfortable truth about spell checking in production software: almost every product uses the same thirty-year-old C++ library, almost nobody understands it, and the moment you need suggestions in a search box, a typo-tolerant API, or a multilingual form, the library you already depend on is the wrong shape for the job.
